Government of India
Directorate General of Health Services
Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO),
Head Quarter, FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-110002.
(PRO Division)
New Delhi.
Dated:
To, 08 ocr 2075

All State/UTs Licensing Authorities
Subject: Creating awareness to the public, stakeholders, applicants & industries
about the recent revision of GST announced by Govt. of India in the medicines,
pharmaceuticals & medical devices etc. — Reg.

With reference to the recent decision of the Government regarding
rationalization of Goods & Services Tax (GST) rate structures wherein the GST rates
of medicines, pharmaceuticals & medical devices have been reduced and will come
into effect from 22.09.2025. The GST rationalization and the consequent public
benefit have to be disseminated to the public through the industry associations, state
drugs authorities, CDSCO offices, stakeholders etc. The campaign has to be
continued till 100 days. It is proposed as under:

State /UTs Licensing Authorities:

e Display banners, posters etc. in your Offices.

e Encourage the manufacturers/wholesalers and retailers directly and through
their associations to disseminate information through banners, posters etc. in
their premises.

e Continuation of the campaign till 100 days.

e Compile the pictures of the actions taken and forward to the CDSCO- HQ.

The hash tags, social media posts, banner and poster texts are enclosed
herewith.
This is for your information & further necessary action as mentioned above.
Yours Faithfully,
